correctness.rationale: For a mixed initial row distribution, variation of constants gives \(p_k(t)=\int_0^t p_3e^{Q_3s}Q_{3k}e^{Q_k(t-s)}\,ds\). With simple Perron mode \(e^{Q_ku}=e^{-lpha_ku}u_k\ell_k+o(e^{-lpha_ku})\) and \(lpha_3>lpha_k\), the forcing integral converges and yields \(A_k=-p_3(Q_3+lpha_kI)^{-1}Q_{3k}u_k(\ell_k\mathbf1)\). Hence \(M_k(t)=A_ke^{-lpha_kt}+o(e^{-lpha_kt})\), so \(M_1/M_2=(A_1/A_2)e^{(lpha_2-lpha_1)t}(1+o(1))\) and the crossing time contains \(-\log(A_1/A_2)/(lpha_2-lpha_1)\). Conditioning on non-extinction cancels from the class-mass ratio. The submitted three-state chain independently shows that fixing the spectral gap while changing entry branching changes the prefactor and therefore the crossing time.
risks: The theorem assumes strict spectral ordering, simple Perron modes and nonzero reachability; resonance or vanishing coefficients require separate asymptotics.
The record does not reconstruct the biological generator and therefore does not certify replacement numerical Table 5 entries.
